subject: does shinyapps support the rDrop package?

messages.author: 084d0345d2a3706f
messages.subject: does shinyapps support the rDrop package?
parts:
I've got it running locally and would love it shinyapps would support it.  (or at least at some point in the future).  Its on github and installs with devtools (https://github.com/karthik/rDrop)

any thoughts? Does anyone have this working for them?

Here's the error i'm getting when running shinyapps:deployApp()

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 1156334 failed: Error building image: Error fetching rDrop (0.3-0) source. Error getting package source URL from GitHub. HTTP 404: Not Found

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] does shinyapps support the rDrop package?
parts:
Justin,

Can you try updating to the latest version of rDrop from GibHub:

devtools::install_github('karthik/rDrop')

and then re-run deployApp()? If it fails can you send the output?

Thanks
-Andy

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] does shinyapps support the rDrop package?
parts:
Justin,

Glad to hear it's working. I think the issue was that the package author changed his username from karthikram to karthik since you installed the package from GitHub. The GitHub username is recorded when you install a package from GitHub using devtools. If it changes, ShinyApps will be unable to find the package source. A somewhat unlikely scenario, but possible.

-Andy
